starters.text: Who was Jesus, to you and your people?
I want to believe in Jesus, but I can't. What would you say to me?
What did you believe about God?
Did belonging cost you anything — family, friends, standing?
What would your people have made of someone like me?

thinness_statement: Synthetic by design: substantive on 5 of Canon v1's 28 cells, honest-limited on the rest, on purpose, to exercise both coverage-gate routes.
